```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

class wan "WAN uplink" stroke=#2563eb
class backup "Backup path" stroke=#dc2626 style=dashed

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Primary Hub Router"
node hubbackup "Backup Hub Router"

edge access1 -- branch
edge access2 -- branch
edge branch -- hubprimary class=wan
edge branch -- hubbackup class=wan,backup
```

Fixed the four edge lines: each needed one of the required operators (`->`, `<-`, `--`, `<->`) between the two node ids. Since these are physical links with no implied direction, I used the undirected `--` operator throughout, keeping the `class=` styling on the WAN uplinks unchanged.
